title: Gold Rate Today, Aug 18: Check latest Gold prices in Mumbai, Ahmedabad, Chennai Delhi, Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Kolkata & Other Cities - The HinduBusinessLine
text:
Gold prices in India rose today across all cities. The price for 8 grams of 24-carat gold also increased in all cities compared to yesterday. | Photo Credit: REUTERS/BHAWIKA CHHABRA

Gold prices in India rose today across all cities. The price for 8 grams of 24-carat gold also increased in all cities compared to yesterday. Below is a detailed breakdown of gold prices in key cities.

Gold prices in India today were ₹14,340 for 1 gram of 22-carat gold (up by ₹20) and ₹1,14,720 for 8 grams of 22-carat gold (up by ₹160).

22 Carat: The gold prices in Mumbai today were ₹14,340 for 1 gram of 22-carat gold (up by ₹20) and ₹1,14,720 for 8 grams of 22-carat gold (up by ₹160).

24 Carat: The gold prices in Mumbai today were ₹15,057 for 1 gram of 24-carat gold (up by ₹21) and ₹1,20,456 for 8 grams of 24-carat gold (up by ₹168).
